title: Align Watch complication navigation and visual surfaces
outcome: Align Watch complication navigation and visual surfaces.

included: Every idle complication and Smart Stack status widget opens the project picker without starting a timer; running and paused taps reopen the current timer.
Accessory surfaces adopt the approved design, remain private by default and respect system rendering and reduced luminance; regression coverage represents the requested navigation.
excluded: Persistence, wire contracts, signing and version allocation.
